newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Kuala Lumpur tin market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Kuala Lumpur tin market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Kuala Lumpur tin market is closed on Friday for the Moslem Eid al-Adha festival. The market reopens on Monday.

On Thursday, tin price fell 14 cents to 14.05 ringgit ($5.60) a kg, in response to an overnight fall on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said. Turnover was 108 tonnes compared with 90 on Wednesday.
The local premium against the LME widened to $60 a tonne from $50 previously.
